name: XlAutoFilterOperator
description: Specifies the operator to use to associate two criteria applied by a filter.

constants.name: xlAnd
constants.description: Logical AND of Criteria1 and Criteria2

constants.name: xlBottom10Items
constants.description: Lowest-valued items displayed (number of items specified in Criteria1)

constants.name: xlBottom10Percent
constants.description: Lowest-valued items displayed (percentage specified in Criteria1)

constants.name: xlOr
constants.description: Logical OR of Criteria1 or Criteria2

constants.name: xlTop10Items
constants.description: Highest-valued items displayed (number of items specified in Criteria1)

constants.name: xlTop10Percent
constants.description: Highest-valued items displayed (percentage specified in Criteria1)
